puzzles.prompt: Learn the ropes: the words on the floor are the rules.

guided_tutorial.speaker: narrator
guided_tutorial.text: Welcome to the Logic room. The word tiles on the floor are RULES — read them.

guided_tutorial.speaker: narrator
guided_tutorial.text: SLIME IS YOU means the slime is you. Press an arrow key to move.

guided_tutorial.speaker: narrator
guided_tutorial.text: FLAG IS WIN means touching the flag wins. Later, rules can be CHANGED — word tiles push like blocks.

guided_tutorial.speaker: narrator
guided_tutorial.text: Made a mess? U undoes a move · R resets the room. Now go touch the flag!

hints.text: Those words on the floor aren't decoration — they are the rules of this room, read left to right.
SLIME IS YOU means the slime is the thing you move. FLAG IS WIN means touching the flag ends the level.
Walk right until you are standing on the flag.

solution.note: walk right onto the flag (win condition lives in the logic pack's board)

metadata.concept: the floor spells the rules

goalSpec.description: Read the two rules written on the floor, then reach the flag.

puzzles.prompt: Push the words to change the rules.

on_enter.speaker: narrator
on_enter.text: A wall, one gap — and something sitting in it.

hints.text: That wall runs the full height of the room. There is exactly one way through it.
Read the third rule: ROCK IS PUSH. That is permission — walk into the rock and it moves.
Shove the rock through the gap, step through behind it, then go down and right to the flag.

solution.note: win conditions live in the logic pack's boards

metadata.concept: one rule per obstacle

goalSpec.description: A rock plugs the only gap in the wall. Read what the rules say the rock is.

puzzles.prompt: Push the words to change the rules.

on_enter.speaker: narrator
on_enter.text: One corridor, one rock, and no room to change your mind.

hints.text: Drive the rock straight at the flag and it wedges against the far wall — with the flag underneath it. U undoes a move; R restarts.
The corridor has pockets above and below. The rock only needs to go somewhere that isn't in front of you.
Go down and around, come up beneath the rock, and shove it UP into the pocket. Then walk the corridor clean.

solution.note: win conditions live in the logic pack's boards

metadata.concept: a push you can't take back

goalSpec.description: Reach the flag. Shoving the rock straight down the corridor will jam it.

puzzles.prompt: Push the words to change the rules.

on_enter.speaker: narrator
on_enter.text: No way around this one. So change the rules instead.

hints.text: There is no gap in that wall. Walking will never get you across.
WALL IS STOP is spelled out on the floor — and written words are objects you can push.
Shove any one of those three words out of its line. The wall stops stopping you; then walk right to the flag.

solution.note: win conditions live in the logic pack's boards

metadata.concept: a rule you must unmake

goalSpec.description: The wall runs floor to ceiling. Change what the wall IS.

puzzles.prompt: Push the words to change the rules.

on_enter.speaker: narrator
on_enter.text: The flag is only a flag until something says otherwise.

hints.text: Stand on the flag and nothing happens. Read the rules and you'll see why.
FLAG IS sits unfinished, with an empty cell after it. There is a loose word lying on the floor.
Push WIN into the empty cell right after FLAG IS, then go stand on the flag.

solution.note: win conditions live in the logic pack's boards

metadata.concept: finish a rule to win

goalSpec.description: FLAG IS … nothing. Complete the sentence before the flag can mean anything.

puzzles.prompt: Push the words to change the rules.

on_enter.speaker: narrator
on_enter.text: No flag anywhere. But there is a rock, and a spare word.

hints.text: Look for the flag. There isn't one — so reaching it was never the plan.
A rule doesn't have to end in a behaviour. ROCK IS ⟨something⟩ can name another OBJECT instead.
Build ROCK IS FLAG. The rock turns into a flag, FLAG IS WIN is already standing, so go touch it.

solution.note: win conditions live in the logic pack's boards

metadata.concept: turning one thing into another

goalSpec.description: There is no flag in this room. Make one.

puzzles.prompt: Two phases: unmake a rule, then finish another beyond the breach.

on_enter.speaker: narrator
on_enter.text: Two jobs. One of them is behind the wall.

hints.text: This is two puzzles stacked: get through the wall, then deal with what is waiting past it.
First break WALL IS STOP the way you did before — push one word out of its line.
Past the wall, FLAG IS is unfinished. WIN is back on YOUR side — bring it through the breach with you.

solution.note: win conditions live in the logic pack's boards

metadata.concept: two rules, one after the other

goalSpec.description: Break the rule that blocks you, then finish the rule that wins — the second one waits on the far side.

puzzles.prompt: The flag is sealed. Deduce which rule actually wins.

on_enter.speaker: narrator
on_enter.text: Sealed in. So the flag was never the way out.

hints.text: Walk over and check: the flag is walled in on all four sides. Stop trying to reach it.
WIN is a loose word. Nothing says it has to finish FLAG IS — it can end a rule about anything you CAN touch.
There is a rock you can reach. Build ROCK IS WIN, then go touch the rock.

solution.note: win conditions live in the logic pack's boards

metadata.concept: the flag is not the answer

goalSpec.description: The flag is sealed in on every side. Something else in this room can be made to win.

puzzles.prompt: Two locks, one path. Break, cross, build, win.

on_enter.speaker: narrator
on_enter.text: Two locks, one path. Take them in the right order.

hints.text: The rock is the only thing plugging the gap in that wall — and right now the rules say it cannot move.
ROCK IS STOP is written on YOUR side of the wall. Break it and the rock stops blocking.
Cross the gap, then finish FLAG IS with the WIN lying on the far side, and touch the flag.

solution.note: win conditions live in the logic pack's boards

metadata.concept: break one rule, build another

goalSpec.description: Two locks: something stops you, and nothing wins yet. Order matters.

puzzles.prompt: Push the words to change the rules.

on_enter.speaker: narrator
on_enter.text: Same room, new layout. Nothing is where you left it.

hints.text: That wall runs the full height of the room. There is exactly one way through it.
Read the third rule: ROCK IS PUSH. That is permission — walk into the rock and it moves.
Shove the rock through the gap, step through behind it, then go down and right to the flag.

solution.note: win conditions live in the logic pack's boards
